source: assets/enemies/turret-01 - The_Turret_1.obj (Blender 5.0 export). Free asset, author not recorded in the download; see HANDOFF before shipping.
_barrel: The muzzle is `lamp` (#ffe7a0, the one role that is a fixed colour rather than a shade
of the body) and NOT `dark`: as `dark` it is #241d2c, which in the first person is a
black hole against an already dark corridor - you cannot tell where the thing is
pointing, and on a turret that is the one thing you must be able to tell. The
alternatives are one word each: `accent` (body x1.32) or `metal` (#585265).
